name: cannavec-science
description: Cannabis-science MVP for the working researcher. Five commands, eight curated science registries (major + minor cannabinoids, terpenes, drug interactions, adverse events, populations, contraindications, pharmacogenomics), six phytochemistry rigor detectors (isomer-collapse, receptor-without-ID, dose-without-route, THCA-vs-THC conflation, matrix-unit confusion, decarb-context-missing), 15 banned-pattern detector, safety preflight, retraction enforcement at composition time, live discovery across PubMed + ChEMBL + ClinicalTrials.gov with deterministic cross-source synthesis, BibTeX/RIS/CSL-JSON bibliography export with inline GRADE annotation. Researcher audience only. Stdlib-only Python ≥ 3.9. Distilled from the 35,500-LOC Cannavec parent plugin into a focused 6,000-LOC MVP that ships one thing exceptionally well.
